+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboWits eai-standard/2.2 controller for cover_with_lid.
+
+The service owns the episode state; this script deliberately has no reset path.
+Run it against the already running service. Each waypoint is absolute and is
+built from the current proprioception so an interrupted run can be inspected.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot  # noqa: E402
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs/cover_with_lid")
+
+
+def observe(robot: Robot, depth: bool = False):
+    return robot.get_obs(depth=depth, video="none")
+
+
+def tcp_now(robot: Robot):
+    o = observe(robot)
+    n = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return o, n[16:30].copy(), n[:16].copy()
+
+
+def pose_row(robot: Robot, updates: dict[str, dict]):
+    """Create a 16-value ee_pose row, retaining current uncommanded tips."""
+    _, tcp, joint = tcp_now(robot)
+    row = np.r_[tcp[0:7], joint[7], tcp[7:14], joint[15]].astype(float)
+    for side, target in updates.items():
+        start = 0 if side == "right" else 8
+        row[start:start + 7] = np.asarray(target["pose"], dtype=float)
+        row[start + 7] = float(target.get("gripper", joint[7 if side == "right" else 15]))
+    return row
+
+
+def move(robot: Robot, note: str, **updates):
+    row = pose_row(robot, updates)
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", row[None, :], video="none", note=note)
+    print(json.dumps({"note": note, "done": result.meta.get("done"),
+                      "reason": result.meta.get("reason"), "plan": result.meta.get("plan"),
+                      "proprio": result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[16:30]}, default=float))
+    if result.done:
+        return result
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    print("status", json.dumps(robot.status()))
+    print("spec", json.dumps({"protocol": robot.spec().get("protocol"),
+                              "budget": robot.spec().get("budget"),
+                              "max_call_wall_s": robot.spec().get("max_call_wall_s")}))
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "observe":
+        o = observe(robot, depth=True)
+        OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for camera, image in o.last.items():
+            from PIL import Image
+            Image.fromarray(image).save(OUT / f"latest_{camera}.png")
+        for camera, depth in o.last_depth.items():

+        print(json.dumps(o.meta, default=str)[:5000])

+    # This initial retract clears the left gripper from the large lid before
